brief.headline: Binance has covered 90% of losses from $6.3 billion hack
brief.detail: Binance says it has covered 90% of losses from the $6.3 billion hack, which the FT describes as crypto theft at an unprecedented scale.

brief.headline: OpenAI cuts fundraising goal to up to $20 billion
brief.detail: OpenAI is now seeking up to $20 billion in its latest round, which has not closed, so the figures are subject to change.

brief.headline: US stocks slide as Amazon, Intel earnings spark AI selling
brief.detail: Amazon and Intel earnings sparked more selling in AI-linked stocks, pushing US stocks lower and deepening concerns about AI capital spending.

brief.headline: OPay makes NYSE debut, raising $304 million in IPO
brief.detail: The emerging-markets fintech raised $304 million in a $19-per-share public offering as it made its NYSE debut.

brief.headline: Anthropic IPO may allot 15% to 20% to US retail
brief.detail: Bloomberg reported a possible 15% to 20% US retail allocation for Anthropic's IPO, which is a key detail for individual investors.
